about.tagline: Your finances. Local, private, on all your devices.
about.description: ZCashflow is a local-first finance app with no cloud and no account: income, expenses, receipts, recurring payments, debts, savings goals and budgets – with a forecast of what's left at the end of the month. Your data stays on your devices and only syncs, encrypted, over your own Wi-Fi.

syncHelp.title: Devices don't find each other or don't sync?
syncHelp.sameWifi: Both devices are in the same Wi-Fi – not a guest network, and the router doesn't isolate devices ("AP isolation" or "client isolation").
syncHelp.bothOpen: ZCashflow is open on both devices. Phones pause apps in the background, so open the app to sync.
syncHelp.vpn: VPNs are turned off on both devices.
syncHelp.byAddress: If a device isn't found, pair it with “{{button}}” and enter the address shown under “{{label}}”.
syncHelp.windowsText: When Windows asks, allow ZCashflow for private networks, and set your Wi-Fi to Private (Settings → Network & internet → Wi-Fi → your network → Private network). Or allow port {{port}} once in PowerShell as administrator:
syncHelp.macText: If the firewall is on, allow incoming connections for ZCashflow (System Settings → Network → Firewall → Options).
syncHelp.linuxText: Most desktop distributions block incoming connections. Allow port {{port}} once in a terminal:
syncHelp.mobileText: On iPhone, allow Local Network for ZCashflow (Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network). On both, Wi-Fi has to be on – mobile data alone doesn't reach the other device. Keep the app open while it syncs.
